news.title: 49ers WR Ricky Pearsall out for the season
news.description: Pearsall underwent PCL reconstruction and is out for the season, the team announced.

news.title: Emeka Egbuka tore his ACL in practice
news.description: Buccaneers rookie Emeka Egbuka tore his ACL on Monday and will miss the season.

news.title: Puka Nacua limited with an ankle issue
news.description: Nacua was limited Wednesday but is expected to play Week 1.

news.title: Nobody Atall placed on injured reserve
news.description: A player who is not in this pool at all was placed on injured reserve.
